description:
# Deku as Lee Sin

Unleash the power of One For All on the Rift.

This mod replaces Lee Sin with **Izuku "Deku" Midoriya** from *My Hero Academia*, bringing the future Symbol of Peace into League of Legends. Featuring a custom model and animation adjustments, the mod reimagines Lee Sin's martial arts combat through Deku's powerful fighting style.

Animations have been carefully adapted to fit the character, creating a more natural and immersive experience while preserving Lee Sin's original gameplay, abilities, and feel. Whether you're landing skill shots, dashing through team fights, or delivering a game-changing ultimate, every move feels worthy of a One For All user.

If you've ever wanted to smash your enemies with the determination of a true hero, this mod lets you take Deku onto the Rift and prove why heroes never give up.
